title: Decompose a timed-out multi-file text probe into bounded per-file reads
failure_signature: A combined pattern scan across three explicitly named x1 working files exceeded its ten-second envelope and returned no usable result set.
trigger_preconditions: combined read-only scan returned no usable output before its deadline
candidate_workaround: Split multi-file working-tree probes by file when shared-drive latency consumes the original envelope, retaining the timed-out command as a negative.
recurrence_guard: Treat timeout-without-output as no evidence; never infer either matches or cleanliness from it.
rollback: Give the combined scan zero review credit and make no x1 claim until the per-file reads complete.
scope_boundary: Same-owner bounded operational recovery only; no scientific, authority, production, accessibility-complete, security-complete, or independent-reproduction credit.
